name: CCameraComponent
summary: A cross-renderer camera component type with an engine-owned UTDS update registration. Its object layout, active instance, and relation to the player-follow camera remain unresolved.

builds.notes: Class and update-registration literals are present in the exact DX11 module.
The same class and update-registration literals are present in the exact DX12 module.

evidence.notes: Exact CCameraComponent and UTDS::xxxUpdate registration literals were found in both fingerprinted renderer modules by bounded, read-only searches.

unknowns: Whether this is the normal active scene camera

name: CCameraGameProcessingComponent
summary: A normal-gameplay camera-processing component with distinct pre-physics, post-input, post-physics, and post-camera update phases plus raycast, lock, visibility, and aiming-assistance methods.

builds.notes: Reflected class/method and UTDS phase literals were inspected from the exact DX11 module.

evidence.notes: The exact class string names UpdatePrePhysics, PrepareVisibilityTests, PrepareAimingAssistanceTests, UpdateZLockAssistance, UpdateGazeToObjectMapping_Raycast, UpdateReticleHitRay_Raycast, UpdateLock, and four UTDS phase registrations.

unknowns: Whether it owns or only consumes the scene-camera transform

name: CCameraFreeComponent
summary: A cross-renderer, non-Photo-Mode-named camera-free component with an engine-owned UTDS update registration. It is a lead for detached gameplay-camera research, not a verified freecam implementation.

builds.notes: An @CameraFreeComponent literal and CCameraFreeComponent UTDS update registration are present in the exact DX11 module.
Matching @CameraFreeComponent and CCameraFreeComponent UTDS update-registration literals are present in the exact DX12 module.

evidence.notes: The exact component name and engine update-registration literal occur in both independently fingerprinted renderers; neither string includes PhotoCamera or FreePhoto.

unknowns: Whether it is enabled in shipping gameplay
Whether it can detach from an operative

name: Normal gameplay camera pipeline
summary: The observed modules contain separate general-camera, gameplay-processing, and camera-free component leads. Their ownership edges must be mapped before a detached gameplay freecam can be implemented safely.

builds.notes: Static type and update-registration evidence only.

evidence.notes: Separate names and update phases establish a research map, but do not prove an ownership relationship or a safe camera-control path.
